summary: Bankroll $10,080.54 (+0.81%) vs SPY +3.25% from baseline — I am 244bps behind buy-and-hold and the gap has widened ~100bps for a third straight session. Found the cause: my 22.8% exposure ceiling was max_position_pct applied to a single ETF, not a risk decision — the SPY core has been maxed out since it filled, so any additional index beta requires additional instruments. Bought 8 IWM @ 300.06 (23.8% of bankroll; gross exposure now 46.6%) on day one of a three-week range breakout: the 10% two-session oil collapse on the pending Hormuz deal plus soft JOLTS and factory orders is a rates story that the tape is still pricing as an AI story (SMH +4.6% and QQQ +2.5% today vs IWM only +1.3%, with TLT essentially unmoved). Invalidation on a close below 295.50 (0.36% of bankroll at risk); SPY core held with invalidation unchanged at a close below 750.

trades.rationale: Day-one breakout above a three-week 288-298 range in the least-extended, most rate-sensitive cohort, into a 10% oil collapse the bond market has not yet priced, with invalidation only 1.5% away at 295.50.
